newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Caracas stocks close flat as all eyes on CANTV.
newsitem.headline: Caracas stocks close flat as all eyes on CANTV.

text.p: Caracas stocks closed flat in slow trade as foreign investors hung back on the sidelines while local investors were absorbed by the CANTV share issue in progress this week and next, traders said.
"It was a particularly quiet and stable session as only local investors are trading," said Bancaracas broker Ricardo Larrazabal.

The bolsa's 19-share .IBC index slipped 0.24 percent to end at 5,822.34 points as 16 shares rose, 17 fell and 11 closed flat. Some 39.4 million shares traded worth 2.1 billion bolivars ($4.5 million).
Fifty million shares in telephone company CANTV are to being sold on the domestic market in a 289 million global share placement.

Traders said the day's only other major developments included the sale of over 24 million shares in real estate company Fondo de Valores Inmobilarios at 22.5 bolivars per share to Activalores brokerage.
Fondo Valores, which is majority owned by financial guru Geroge Soros through the Argentine company Irsa International, closed at 22.5 bolivars.
